plain: A sudden, great disaster that brings deep suffering.

webster.text: Any great misfortune, or cause of misery; generally applied to events or disasters which produce extensive evils, as loss of crops, earthquakes, conflagrations, defeat of armies, and the like.

example.quote: The most furious private wars, accompanied with every species of calamity, were carried on between the different princes and states.
example.cite: The Federalist No. 19 (Madison, with Hamilton), Dec. 8, 1787
